informal_statement: Issue #302 C1: among position-dependent letter substitutions (a frame among the 384 signed axis permutations and a multiplicity at each position), ZFA admits no local scale or frame symmetry. Its symmetry is global: 96 fold-preserving frames times the odd dilations; even dilations preserve ZFA and erase the phase. This is outcome 2 of C1 and meets the issue's failure criterion, so the intrinsic Weyl route has no first step in this class.

approximation_or_regime.name: Letter-substitution class
approximation_or_regime.description: Histories of length <= 6 over the 8-twist alphabet; position-dependent frames and multiplicities k_p in {1,2,3}; ZFA = count balance; fold = Pauli product.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: Letter substitutions only. Closure-respecting rewrites that are not letter substitutions are not tested.

formal_statement.statement_scope: Global dilations preserve balance at every length; odd ones preserve the fold and even ones send it to 1; one local dilation witness breaks balance. The exhaustive W3/W4 field censuses and the 96-frame count are numerical.

formal_object.type: symmetry classification of a closure predicate

strange_loop.conservative_return: Every surviving transformation returns ZFA and the fold unchanged (odd dilations, 96 frames); no local one survives.
strange_loop.noncircularity_witness: The class is defined without reference to conformal geometry and the survivors were counted, not assumed.
strange_loop.first_order_note: F: QLF_ConformalComparison anchors. N: conformal_comparison.py, exhaustive to length 6.
strange_loop.defeater: A non-constant letter-substitution field that preserves ZFA on every balanced history of some length; or a local symmetry from another primitive class, which would reopen C1 outside this class.

measurement_protocol.design: No empirical measurement. Pre-registered W1-W5 in Conformal_Comparison.md section 1, run by exhaustive enumeration.
measurement_protocol.failure_condition: Verdict rule: if W3 and W4 pass there is no local symmetry in the class (outcome 2).

reported_agreement.value: no local symmetry; global symmetry = 96 frames x odd dilations
